Solution: Keep the drawing and real units in the stated order. The conversion in the requested direction is 5/1; multiply the given length 9: 9*(5/1)=45. The result uses the real-world unit requested by the question.

Question Choices: A 1.5 m person casts a 2 m shadow while a tree casts a 10 m shadow. Find the tree height. Assume upright objects on level ground with shadows measured at the same time.
Solution: For upright objects on level ground at the same time, the sun makes equal ray angles, giving similar right triangles. Height/shadow is constant: h/10=(3/2)/(2). Thus h=10*(3/2)/(2)=15/2 m.

Solution: Use the same direction for corresponding ratios. The required length multiplier is 18/6; multiply the known corresponding length 9: x=9*(18/6)=27. This preserves the shape and all corresponding side ratios.
